source: Without {0}, Nuxt recompiles a template on every watched file change because it cannot know what the template reads. Templates with {1} are an exception: they recompile only when their source file changes. If your template is built only from configuration and from which files exist, declare that so Nuxt can leave it alone when a file is edited:
